title: Use synchronous scene identity to prevent insight editor autosaves
answers: Why does changing chart type save the insight without clicking Save?
Why does the insight editor exit edit mode and show Insight updated?
Which scene state should isInsightSceneInstance compare?
How should persistDisplayOptions handle a stale insightLogicRef?
body:
Symptom: Selecting a chart type saves the insight without clicking Save, exits edit mode, and shows “Insight updated.”
Root cause: frontend/src/scenes/insights/insightDataLogic.tsx:isInsightSceneInstance previously checked insightLogicRef, which a separate asynchronous listener rebuilds; that ref can lag the editor's current identity and let a PATCH through.
Fix pattern: Determine scene ownership from insightId and dashboardId, updated synchronously by the URL-matching action, so persistDisplayOptions skips the PATCH for the insight currently shown in the editor.
Constraints: isInsightSceneInstance requires the active scene to be Scene.Insight, insightId to match props.dashboardItemId, and dashboardId to match props.dashboardId with null and undefined treated equally. Preserve dashboard context; the editor-instance guard does not apply outside that scene or to a different instance.
applies: Insight display-option persistence and guards that identify the insight currently open in the editor.
